INSERT INTO T_TREASURE(TREASURE_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY, TYPE, COST, IMGSRC, CODESRC, CAN_BUY, CAN_GIFT_CERTIFICATE_BUY, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP, STATE) VALUES(#treasureID#, #name#, #description#, #category#, #type#, #cost#, #imgSrc#, #codeSrc#, #canBuy#, #canGiftCertificateBuy#, #directUseTooltip#, #state#)
SELECT @@IDENTITY AS ID
sqlMap.update: UPDATE T_TREASURE SET TREASURE_ID=#treasureID#, NAME=#name#, DESCRIPTION=#description#, CATEGORY=#category#, TYPE=#type#, COST=#cost#, IMGSRC=#imgSrc#, CODESRC=#codeSrc#, CAN_BUY=#canBuy#, CAN_GIFT_CERTIFICATE_BUY=#canGiftCertificateBuy#, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP=#directUseTooltip#, STATE=#state# WHERE TREASURE_ID=#treasureID#
sqlMap.select: SELECT TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NAME AS name, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, TYPE AS type, COST AS cost, IMGSRC AS imgSrc, CODESRC AS codeSrc, CAN_BUY AS canBuy, CAN_GIFT_CERTIFICATE_BUY AS canGiftCertificateBuy, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP AS directUseTooltip, STATE AS state FROM T_TREASURE WHERE TREASURE_ID=#treasureID#

SELECT TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NAME AS name, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, TYPE AS type, COST AS cost, IMGSRC AS imgSrc, CODESRC AS codeSrc, CAN_BUY AS canBuy, CAN_GIFT_CERTIFICATE_BUY AS canGiftCertificateBuy, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP AS directUseTooltip, STATE AS state FROM T_TREASURE

SELECT TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NAME AS name, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, TYPE AS type, COST AS cost, IMGSRC AS imgSrc, CODESRC AS codeSrc, CAN_BUY AS canBuy, CAN_GIFT_CERTIFICATE_BUY AS canGiftCertificateBuy, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP AS directUseTooltip, STATE AS state FROM T_TREASURE WHERE CAN_BUY=1 AND CATEGORY=#category#

SELECT TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NAME AS name, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, TYPE AS type, COST AS cost, IMGSRC AS imgSrc, CODESRC AS codeSrc, CAN_BUY AS canBuy, CAN_GIFT_CERTIFICATE_BUY AS canGiftCertificateBuy, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP AS directUseTooltip, STATE AS state FROM T_TREASURE WHERE TYPE=#type#

SELECT TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NAME AS name, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, TYPE AS type, COST AS cost, IMGSRC AS imgSrc, CODESRC AS codeSrc, CAN_BUY AS canBuy, CAN_GIFT_CERTIFICATE_BUY AS canGiftCertificateBuy, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP AS directUseTooltip, STATE AS state FROM T_TREASURE WHERE CAN_BUY=1 AND STATE=#state#

SELECT TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NAME AS name, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, TYPE AS type, COST AS cost, IMGSRC AS imgSrc, CODESRC AS codeSrc, CAN_BUY AS canBuy, CAN_GIFT_CERTIFICATE_BUY AS canGiftCertificateBuy, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP AS directUseTooltip, STATE AS state FROM T_TREASURE WHERE CAN_BUY=1 AND (STATE=1 OR STATE=2)
